hazards.verification_status_label: Prospective live scoring is active for matured earthquake windows.
hazards.metric_source_label: Pre-registered programme (docs/EARTHQUAKE_FORECAST_PROGRAM.md): scored once on 2023-2025 (153 issue times, 1384 M6+ cell-windows); +2.60 nats of information per quake over a uniform map. This version's live record starts when its first 30-day windows mature.

exact_model_benchmark.label: Pre-registered programme (docs/EARTHQUAKE_FORECAST_PROGRAM.md): scored once on 2023-2025 (153 issue times, 1384 M6+ cell-windows); +2.60 nats of information per quake over a uniform map.

related_benchmark.label: Related research benchmark exists, but it is not yet bound to the current live model version.

hazards.recommended_action: Keep freezing every earthquake forecast. Once the first 30-day windows mature, run the prospective scorer and use those scores to tune thresholds and calibration.

hazards.verification_status_label: Prospective live scoring is active for matured hurricane forecasts. 10 storm forecasts scored against NHC best track; 0 rapid-intensification events observed.

ledger.since: 2026-10-03 (earlier hurricane forecasts are kept as replay files, unchained)

exact_model_benchmark.label: Pre-registered program: candidate A chosen on 2020-2024 by forward chaining, then scored once on the 2025 season (601 NHC-basin cycles, 44 rapid-intensification events, intervals by storm).

hazards.recommended_action: Keep scoring matured hurricane forecasts against NHC best track; live AUC stays undefined until at least one rapid-intensification event is observed, so promotion decisions still rest on the retrospective benchmark.

hazards.verification_status_label: Prospective live scoring is active for matured tornado forecasts.
hazards.metric_source_label: Pre-registered programme (docs/TORNADO_MODEL_PROGRAM.md): every choice made on 2023, development test 2024, scored once on every 2025 storm observation (1,469,977; 1,579 tornadic). No storm forecast of this model version has been scored yet.

prospective.outcome_time_convention: SPC daily files are convective days (12 UTC to 12 UTC); HHMM is UTC; rows before 1200 are placed on the next UTC date
prospective.skill_reference: bss_vs_causal_climatology: reference = base rate of all storm-forecasts whose 24 h window matured before the forecast was issued (no outcome leak). bss_vs_sample_climatology: reference = pooled base rate of the scored set itself (in-sample, shown for comparison).

exact_model_benchmark.label: Pre-registered programme (docs/TORNADO_MODEL_PROGRAM.md): every choice made on 2023, development test 2024, scored once on every 2025 storm observation (1,469,977; 1,579 tornadic).

related_benchmark.label: A historical 2024 holdout benchmark exists for a related tornado GBT family, but not yet as an exact score for the live storm-object model. Its Brier/BSS were measured at a downsampled base rate of 0.003 and are not comparable to live skill at the natural base rate.

hazards.recommended_action: Judge the live tornado model on the pooled BSS against causal climatology (and its served-probability split), not on per-forecast means or the downsampled research holdout.
